blocks.text: 这意味着从HBM装入的每个字节，在下一个字节到达之前，可以执行312×1012 /(2×1012) 156浮点操作。如果您的内核每字节的FLOP数量少于156，则它受内存约束 — 计算单元闲置等待数据。
blocks.originalExcerpt: That means for every byte loaded from HBM you can do 312 × 1012 /(2 × 1012 ) ≈ 156 floating-point operations before the next byte arrives. If your kernel does fewer than 156 FLOPs per byte, it is memory-bound – the compute units are idle waiting for data.

blocks.text: 注册。 每个 CUDA 线索都可以访问私人注册文件。 注册是芯片上最快的存储 — — 读写在单个时钟周期中进行，没有仲裁。 A100 拥有每SM 65 536 32位注册。向本地内存(L1/L2)喷洒登记簿是主要性能危险。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Registers. Each CUDA thread has access to a private register file. Registers are the fastest storage on the chip – reads and writes happen in a single clock cycle with no arbitration. The A100 has 65,536 32-bit registers per SM. Spilling registers to local memory (L1/L2) is a major performance hazard.

blocks.originalExcerpt: L2 Cache. The 40 MB L2 on A100 is shared across all 108 SMs. It acts as a staging area between SRAM and HBM. For workloads with good spatial locality (e.g., weight matrices accessed repeatedly across a batch), L2 hit rates can dramatically reduce effective HBM traffic.

blocks.text: HBM – High Bandwidth Memory。 HBM是直接挂在GPU包上的堆叠DRAM，通过宽插管连接。 A100 SXM在2 TB/s时有80 GB的HBM2e。 H100 SXM5在3.35 TB/s时有80 GB的HBM3. 这是模型重， KV缓存，激活，和优化状态的主要工作内存。
blocks.originalExcerpt: HBM – High Bandwidth Memory. HBM is stacked DRAM mounted directly on the GPU package, connected via a wide interposer. The A100 SXM has 80 GB of HBM2e at 2 TB/s. The H100 SXM5 has 80 GB of HBM3 at 3.35 TB/s. This is the primary working memory for model weights, KV caches, activations, and optimizer states.

近零废物。 内部碎裂最多以每个序列(最后一个区块)一个部分填充的区块为界。 区块尺寸为16，最坏的废物为每个序列15个令牌 — — 微不足道。外部的分裂被消除，因为块是固定大小的，可以互换。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Near-zero waste. Internal fragmentation is bounded by at most one partially-filled block per sequence (the last block). With block size 16, worst-case waste is 15 tokens per sequence – negligible. External fragmentation is eliminated because blocks are fixed-size and interchangeable.

blocks.text: 动态分配。 块会随序列的增长而随需求而分配。 不需要提前知道最终序列长度。 对于输出长度未知的生成来说， 这一点至关重要。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Dynamic allocation. Blocks are allocated on demand as the sequence grows. No need to know the final sequence length in advance. This is critical for generation, where output length is unknown.

blocks.text: 前缀共享(copy-on-write)。共享一个共同前缀的多个序列(例如系统提示)可以共享该前缀的相同物理块，区块表只是将多个序列指向同一个物理块。当一个序列需要写入共享块(从前缀中跳出)时，会触发一个复制到写。 Prefix sharet Seavt in a calbot with a 1000-token system exactly serving 128 along users:
blocks.originalExcerpt: Prefix sharing (copy-on-write). Multiple sequences sharing a common prefix (e.g., a system prompt) can share the same physical blocks for that prefix. The block table simply points multiple sequences to the same physical blocks. When a sequence needs to write to a shared block (diverging from the prefix), a copy-on-write is triggered. blocks.text: 通过互换进行预置。当GPU内存耗尽时， vLLM可以通过将其KV块交换到CPU DRAM(或者简单地丢弃它们，然后重算)来预先控制一个序列。这样做之所以可行，是因为块块是自成一体的，而且不相连接的，因为交换毗连的分配需要复制整个缓冲器。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Preemption via swap. When GPU memory is exhausted, vLLM can preempt a sequence by swapping its KV blocks to CPU DRAM (or simply discarding them and recomputing later). This is only feasible because blocks are self-contained and non-contiguous – swapping a contiguous allocation would require copying the entire buffer.

blocks.originalExcerpt: Traditional batching (“static batching“) waits until all sequences in a batch finish before starting new ones. If one sequence generates 500 tokens and another generates 10, the GPU is idle for 490 steps on the short sequence. This is extremely wasteful. Continuous Batching Continuous batching (also called iteration-level scheduling) processes one decode ste...

blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Check which sequences have finished (generated EOS token)

blocks.text: 2. 从批次中删除已完成的序列，释放其KV块
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Remove finished sequences from the batch, freeing their KV blocks

blocks.text: 3. 增加新的等待顺序以填补空闲的空档
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Add new waiting sequences to fill the freed slots

blocks.originalExcerpt: 4. Run the next decode step with the updated batch

blocks.text: 批量成分会改变每个步骤 — — 序列会加入并动态离开。 这让GPU利用率接近100%，并显著提高吞吐量(1.5-3×大于静态批量 )。页面标记在这里至关重要: 中批添加/删除序列需要动态 KV 块分配/处理位置，这只与页面内存有效。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The batch composition changes every step — sequences join and leave dynamically. This keeps GPU utilization near 100% and dramatically improves throughput (1.5–3× over static batching). PagedAttention is essential here: adding/removing sequences mid-batch requires dynamic KV block allocation/deallocation, which is only efficient with paged memory.
